$Comment: A daily contract for being counted at a boss fight. It swaps its skeleton's Kind to ENCOUNTER_ATTEMPT, which is credited to every participant when a fight settles, the defeat and the wipe alike, and even to one whose share of the work fell under the fight's own minimum, so it is a real ask without being a kill. No Target means any boss. The step's own line (objective.text.bounty.muster_roll) is worded for a single fight, so raise Amount and reword that key with it. On a server where no boss stands anywhere this can never be finished, so take it off the board with Enabled: false.
